Couldn\'t find BeamNG.drive. In the game enable Options → Controls → Hardware → “Use your phone or tablet”, and keep the phone on the same Wi-Fi.
Easiest is the Connect button — no code needed. Otherwise take a clear photo of the game\'s QR and read it here, or paste the link / type the 5-digit code if you already have it.
No QR found in that photo — take a closer, sharper shot of just the QR.
This page shows YOUR real values. Type them into the game exactly as written — no guessing, no copying from screenshots.
— connect the phone to Wi-Fi (or turn on its hotspot) and this page will fill it in —
Turn your phone into the steering wheel, gas and brake for the car in the game.
Connect your phone to the SAME Wi-Fi as your PC — the same home network / router. This is the one thing that must be right.
On your PC in BeamNG.drive: open Options → Controls → Hardware, find “Use your phone or tablet” and set it to Yes. A QR code appears — you can ignore it.
Come back to this app and tap the big CONNECT button. The first search can take 2–3 minutes on 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi; after that it connects in seconds. No QR, no typing.
Why not the QR: since v0.39 the game’s QR became too dense for most phone cameras to read. The Connect button skips the camera and finds the game over your Wi-Fi, so it works on any phone.
The Connect button works for almost everyone. If it can’t find the game (a few Wi-Fi networks block it), try one of these:
Tap Scan QR and point your phone’s camera at the QR on your PC screen. Hold the phone steady and fairly close — it connects on its own.
B · Read the QR from a photo
Take a clear, close photo of the QR on your PC screen. Then tap Enter code → READ QR FROM A PHOTO and choose that photo. The app reads it and connects.

Only if you already have the code. Where to find it: point ANY QR app — your normal phone camera or Google Lens — at the game’s QR. It opens a Google Play link that ends with “#12345”. Those last 5 digits ARE your code. Type them under Enter code.
Unlocks on the drive screen: live speed, RPM needle, gear, fuel, engine temperature, turbo boost, real warning lights (signals, high beam, handbrake, ABS, TC, oil, battery) and crash vibration.
Tick “OutGauge UDP protocol” and fill in the values below
Reload the vehicle once (Ctrl+R) — the game reads this when the car spawns
Shows a live drift angle above the speedometer while you slide, plus your session record. Great with the 0-100 timer (enable it in the app\'s Settings).
In game: Options → Advanced → Protocols (same place)
Tick “MotionSim UDP protocol” and fill in the values below
Nothing arrives? Allow BeamNG.drive through the Windows Firewall.
Guest/hotel Wi-Fi often blocks phones from talking to PCs — use your own network or the phone\'s hotspot.
Router gave the phone a new IP? Re-check this page and update the game, then Ctrl+R.
Gauges frozen after a game update? Re-tick the options — settings occasionally reset.
No router? Turn on the phone\'s hotspot, connect the PC to it, and use the address shown at the top of this page.
Gauges stay empty in split-screen? The game switches its dashboard stream off while multi-seat is on.

Phone and PC must be on the same network: their IP addresses start with the same three numbers (192.168.0.x and 192.168.31.x are different networks). A house with several routers often splits them. Connect both to the same Wi-Fi, or turn on the PC\'s Mobile hotspot and connect the phone to it.

The game shows a firewall lock next to \"Use your phone or tablet\"? It checks only once, when you switch the option on, and does not update afterwards. Switch it off and on again to recheck; whether the phone connects is what counts.
Align the code shown in the game — connects automatically
No connection — connect from the main menu first
Phone and PC must be on the same Wi-Fi — or the PC on the phone\'s hotspot
Step by step, with your own values
Community fork of BeamNG\'s Remote Control app. Not affiliated with BeamNG GmbH.
A short tick on every shift
Crashes, stronger the harder the hit. Most reliable with MotionSim on
Jumps, drops and big potholes. Needs MotionSim
Pulses while traction control or ESC steps in
Buzzes while the engine is at the redline
Tilt the phone like a steering wheel
Turn the wheel on the screen with your finger
Wheel on the right, pedals on the left
Let go of the on-screen wheel in a slide and it counter-steers like a real one — needs MotionSim on in the game
How hard the released wheel is pulled back — the force-feedback strength of a wheel set
Tilt the phone this far for full steering lock
Vibration for what happens to the car
Launch times on the dash, session best
Pedal follows finger position — requires the RemoteControlPro mod
Not detected yet. The mod is optional: without it everything else works as before.
Connects in about a second, with no code and no QR
Gear shift, handbrake and horn on the drive screen
Headlights, fog lights, turn signals and hazard lights
Recover: puts the car back on the road after a crash
Rev counter and steering wheel match the car you are driving
On your PC, download remotecontrolpro_umutsevimcann.zip from the Releases page of this app on GitHub.
Move the zip, without extracting it, into the game\'s mods folder: AppData › Local › BeamNG › BeamNG.drive › current › mods
Start the game and tap Connect in this app. A MOD label on the drive screen shows the link is active.
Nothing in the game is replaced. To remove the mod, delete the zip. If the mod is not found, the app connects the usual way.
Above the pedals: tap to apply, tap again to release
A row under the gauges: lights, fog, signals, hazards, recover
A small add-on for the game. The app works without it; add it and the phone can do what the game\'s own phone remote cannot.
Connecting searches for the game\'s code: the first time can take 2–3 minutes
The rev counter guesses the redline; the on-screen wheel always turns the same amount
The gauges still come from chapter 2 (Live dashboard). The mod adds controls, not gauges.
Drive mode / ESC, 4WD, low range, diff lock, nitrous and doors
Force-feedback steering: let go of the on-screen wheel and the car turns it, as on a wheel set
Camera, automatic/manual gearbox, reset, pause, map and interact keys, and looking around by dragging the gauges
Let go of the on-screen wheel and it returns by estimate, not by the car\'s real forces
Tap the ⋯ key at the end of the key row to reach these. A key only appears on cars that have that system. Needs mod 2.1 or newer.
ESC key: next drive mode, or next ESC / traction control mode
Switches four-wheel drive on and off
N₂O key: arms or disarms the nitrous system
One key: opens the doors, hood and trunk, then closes them
Switches the transfer case between high and low range
Tap the ⋯ key at the end of the key row to reach these. Needs mod 2.2 or newer.
Puts the car back where it started, repaired
With tilt steering both thumbs are free: put the brake under one and the gas under the other
Latched stays on until you tap again; held is on only while your thumb is on it, for drifting
Where the horn is: a key under the wheel, the centre of the wheel, or both
Opens and closes the big map. Needs mod 2.3
Opens the game\'s menu and turns the phone into a menu pad: arrows, select, back and tabs. Needs mod 2.4
Steer the game\'s menus from the phone: arrows, select, back and tabs
Gets out of the car and back in. On foot the phone switches to a walking screen. Needs mod 2.3
On foot the phone becomes a walking screen: a stick to walk, drag on the right to look, keys to jump, crouch and get back in
Appears by itself when you get out of the car: a stick on the left walks, dragging on the right looks around.
Which thumb walks; the look area and keys take the other side
Push the stick to the edge
How far a drag on the right turns the camera
Needs the RemoteControlPro mod, version 2.3 or newer. The game\'s own phone remote cannot walk.
Dragging up looks down, like a flight stick
Turn the phone to look around; dragging still works
How far turning the phone turns the camera
Start missions, jobs and taxi rides you walk up to
Narrows the view to see far, like binoculars; press again to go back
Starts the mission or job you are next to. Needs mod 2.3
Drag the gauges to turn the camera; the game centres it again. Needs mod 2.3
